content.tagline: MOBILE SENIOR // COMPLETE APPS // WEB + CMS
content.bio: Senior mobile developer. I design and ship fully functional iOS/Android apps with their official website, CMS and backoffice. Own products: TerraLiam and App MiDoc. Stack: Flutter/Dart, TypeScript, Next.js/Vue, Supabase, Firebase, maps, camera, auth, notifications and applied AI.

services.pageTitle: Fully functional mobile apps, with web and CMS
services.mobileText: iOS/Android apps with Flutter: maps, camera, auth, notifications, media and Play Store / App Store release. Clean architecture and production-ready UX.
services.fullstackText: The product website and the panel to run it: users, content, metrics, roles and publishing. Next.js/Vue, Supabase/Firebase, auth and storage.
services.productText: App + web + backend + CMS. From concept to release: discovery, UI, APIs, privacy, CI/CD and stores. A senior who closes the loop.

faq.a1: QuintanaDev is Juniors Quintana's software studio in Caracas, Venezuela. Senior mobile development: fully functional iOS/Android apps with their official website, CMS and backoffice.
faq.q2: What kind of products do you build?
faq.a2: Complete systems. TerraLiam: family game with maps, camera and AI, official web and Ops panel. App MiDoc: mobile clinical management for patients, doctors and admins, plus its web. Also custom landings and CMS.
faq.a3: Use the contact form on this page. The team operates on UTC-4 (Caracas).
